'''James Martin''' (also published as '''James A. Martin'''; forums handles '''Solidsnack3''' and '''Solidsnck'''; GEMP handle '''Solidsnck''')<ref name="cc1" /><ref name="pcchart">PC organization chart PDF (created 6 May 2024), [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF]; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live PDF]</ref> played the [[2021 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-match-play-championship/ 2021 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162110/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive].</ref> He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1997.<ref name="list-20817">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/20817.html? swccg-discussion message #20817], James A. Martin (1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000309101050/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/20817.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
